void-combobox.intro: Pattern: [combobox with listbox popup](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/) (editable, list autocomplete, manual selection). The native `<input>` is the `combobox` and keeps DOM focus; the highlighted option is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`. `aria-expanded` and `open` track the list.

Opens the list on the last option, or highlights the previous option (wraps)

Chooses the highlighted option and closes the list. With no option highlighted the key is left alone, so a surrounding form submits
Closes the list
Move the text cursor
Closes the list and moves on without choosing
Filter the options; nothing is highlighted until you arrow to it

void-multiselect.intro: Pattern: [select-only combobox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/) with a [multiselectable listbox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/listbox/) popup. The trigger is the `combobox` (focusable, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`); the list is `aria-multiselectable` and the list stays open while options are toggled. The remove buttons on the selected pills are for the pointer; from the keyboard, toggle the option in the list.

void-tabs.intro: Pattern: [tabs with manual activation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/examples/tabs-manual/) (default) or [automatic activation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/examples/tabs-automatic/) with `activation="auto"`. The tab list is one tab stop (roving tabindex): the selected tab, or the first enabled tab while none is selected. Each tab controls its panel and each panel is labelled by its tab; the visible panel is itself a tab stop. Mark a `<void-tab-panel disabled>` to disable its tab.

rows.action: Enters the tab list on its tab stop, then moves to the visible panel
Move focus to the next or previous tab (wraps). With `activation="auto"` the tab is selected too
Move focus to the first or last tab (selects it with `activation="auto"`)
Select the focused tab (manual activation)

void-segmented-control.intro: Pattern: [radio group](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/radio/). `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` items and `aria-checked` from the first paint. One tab stop: the checked item, or the first enabled item while none is checked. Selection follows focus, so each arrow key fires `void-change`.

rows.action: Move into and out of the group
Select the next item (wraps). With nothing selected, the first
Select the previous item (wraps). With nothing selected, the last
Selects the focused item

void-menu.intro: Pattern: [menu](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/). The list inside `<void-menu>` is the `menu` and its items are `menuitem`s (groups are `group`s). The items are one tab stop, and the tab stop follows focus. Keys are handled on the menu, so arrow keys keep working in every other control on the page.

void-dropdown-menu.intro: Pattern: [menu button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/). The trigger gets `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the panel is a `menu` labelled by the trigger. Items take focus from the keyboard handling, not from Tab.
